rollups.text: Books and reading: The user enjoys fast-paced, twisty psychological thrillers and is open to new authors (2023-04-02; T86). The user finished an unspecified thriller by 2023-03-26, attended an event where its author discussed it, and found the discussion interesting (2023-03-26..2023-04-02; T84). The user met the author of The Silent Patient and was especially interested in reading that novel (2023-04-02; T88, T89, T90). The user keeps a reading journal and decided to add a five-star rating system; they considered but did not decide whether to add a DNF section (2023-04-02; T90, T94, T95). Recommendations included Gone Girl, The Silent Patient, The 7 1/2 Deaths of Evelyn Hardcastle, The Devil in the White City, The Last Time I Lied, The Couple Next Door, The Poison Tree, The Woman in the Window, The Girl on the Train, The Wife Between Us, and The Last Mrs. Parrish (2023-04-02; T87, T89).

Mindfulness and meditation: The user attended a one-day mindfulness and self-care workshop on 2023-02-27 and a five-day mindfulness retreat in March 2023 (2023-02-27..2023-03-31; sources not supplied). The user reports meditation has helped reduce anxiety since the retreat (2023-03-01..2023-03-31; T170). The user has been working to establish a daily meditation habit, including loving-kindness meditation, but has struggled with consistency; the noisy living room prompted interest in creating a dedicated practice space (2023-04-02; T170, T171, T174, T175; additional records without source IDs). The user was considering trying Insight Timer and Meditopia, with no final app choice stated (2023-04-02; source not supplied).

Comedy activities: The user listens to Laugh Out Loud, which inspires them to pursue comedy (2023-04-02; T312, T318), takes a Sunday comedy-writing workshop focused on joke structure and delivery (2023-04-02; T314, T316), and attended a stand-up writing workshop at a local comedy club where they wrote five new jokes (2023-04-02; T354). The user has performed stand-up, watched comedy specials including Hannah Gadsby's Nanette for a third time, and wants to improve delivery and stage presence (2023-04-02; T344, T346). A difficult open-mic night with new material, a tough crowd, and a heckler occurred during the week before 2023-04-02 (2023-03-27..2023-04-02; T350). The user is considering a comedy blog with a witty, sarcastic, slightly self-deprecating voice, drawing on stories about accounting and pursuing comedy (2023-04-02; T318, T320, T322).

Art and photography interests: The user has long been interested in photography but is a beginner; after considering a local photography group, they chose to start with a smartphone and avoid major equipment spending (2023-04-02; T76, T77, T78, T80). A guided tour at the Modern Art Gallery focused on Abstract Expressionism and sparked interest in Jackson Pollock and Mark Rothko (on or shortly before 2023-04-02; source IDs not supplied). The user attended an art workshop in March 2023, volunteered at the Children's Museum Art Day, and wanted to keep exploring painting despite limited experience (2023-03..2023-04-02; source IDs not supplied). They chose Winsor & Newton Galeria paints and brushes and planned a home workspace, online learning through YouTube and Skillshare (possibly Bob Ross tutorials), and regular practice with specific goals (2023-04-02; source IDs not supplied).

Consumer electronics and accessories discussed or purchased: The user bought a Samsung Galaxy S22 Ultra for $799 on sale and was happy with it (2023-04-02; T188, T194), wore a Fossil Gen 5 smartwatch and found its activity and sleep tracking accurate (2023-04-02; T194), bought an Anker portable power bank for $39 (2023-04-02; T196), and ordered an Aukey wireless car charger for $25 (2023-04-02; T198). The user considered a gaming laptop and planned to inspect Dell Alienware and Razer Blade 15 models in person; they also compared Apple Watch Series 7 with Fossil Gen 5 (2023-04-02; T188, T190, T192, T193).

Volunteering and community support: The user has volunteered serving breakfast to people in need and found it fulfilling (2023-04-02; T434). They expressed interest in food-bank work involving food distribution and interaction with clients and said they were eager to get started, but no specific food bank, shift, or start date was established (2023-04-02; T436, T438, T442, T444). The user planned to start volunteering with The Dayton Foodbank (2023-04-02; source IDs not supplied). The user also volunteered at the Love is in the Air fundraising dinner around 2023-02-14 and enjoyed the social atmosphere, auction, and raffles (2023-02-14; source IDs not supplied). They were interested in attending Best Friends Animal Society's Strut Your Mutt in Los Angeles in September 2023 with friends, especially for the silent auction and raffles; attendance was not confirmed (2023-09; source IDs not supplied).

Daily mindfulness practice and anxiety: On 2023-02-27, the user attended a one-day mindfulness and self-care workshop (source ID not supplied). In March 2023, the user attended a five-day mindfulness retreat and began practicing meditation; they reported that it helped reduce anxiety (2023-03-01..2023-03-31; T170). By 2023-04-02, the user wanted meditation to become a daily habit and was incorporating loving-kindness practice, but struggled with consistency and a noisy living room; they considered creating a dedicated meditation space and trying personalized meditation apps, without selecting one (2023-04-02; T170, T171, T174, T175; app and room details have no source IDs). Elapsed time from the workshop to the April follow-up: about five weeks; from the retreat: roughly days to one month.

Photography learning plan: On 2023-04-02, the user said they were new to photography, had long been interested, and was considering a local group or club as a way to meet people and challenge themselves (T76, T77, T78). Concerned about equipment and cost, the user decided to begin with a smartphone, experiment with camera modes, angles, and editing, and gain experience before considering a basic camera kit (T78, T80, T81, T82). The plan remained low-cost and exploratory at the latest recorded point; no camera purchase or group membership was reported. Elapsed time between recorded steps: same day.

Stand-up comedy development: By 2023-04-02, the user had tried performing a first stand-up set and wanted to improve delivery and stage presence (T344). During the week before that date, an open-mic set with new material went poorly amid a tough crowd and a heckler; the user was trying not to be discouraged (2023-03-27..2023-04-02; T350). The user attended a comedy-writing workshop and produced five new jokes, excited to try them out (2023-04-02; T354). They were also taking a Sunday writing workshop and planned to try a new bit about working as an accountant at an upcoming open mic (T314, T316). The user listens to Laugh Out Loud and is considering a comedy blog, with a conversational, witty, sarcastic, self-deprecating style (T312, T318, T320, T322). The latest records show plans to keep writing and performing, but do not confirm a subsequent performance of the new jokes. Elapsed span of the explicitly dated open-mic difficulty: within the week before 2023-04-02.

Making the home more sustainable: On 2023-04-02, the user wanted to reduce home energy use with insulation and solar panels and planned to research an installer (sources include T261; other planning records have no source IDs). Feeling overwhelmed, the user chose a more manageable initial step: switch to LED lighting and install low-flow fixtures (2023-04-02; source ID not supplied). They wanted stylish products that fit their decor and received suggestions including Philips Hue, Lutron, Kohler, Delta, and TOTO (2023-04-02; T270). The user also asked about natural cleaning products and composting, but no completed installation or other action was reported (2023-04-02; T263, T264; composting record has no source ID). Elapsed time between the initial goal and the narrowed first steps: same day.

Career reflection and possible transition: On 2023-04-02, the user felt stuck and questioned whether their job aligned with their values and passions (T176, T178). They were considering taking a course or earning a certification in a more interesting field, but felt scared to make the leap (T176, T178). They requested resources and received suggestions for career research, manageable courses, informational interviews, and building a financial safety net (T177, T179). No course enrollment, target field, or transition was reported. All recorded steps occurred on the same date.

Personal spending and impulse-purchase plans: During the week before 2023-04-02, the user made an over-budget $500 impulse purchase of a designer handbag and said Instagram fashion and luxury-product accounts can trigger urges to splurge (2023-03-26..2023-04-01; T398, T400). On 2023-04-02, the user planned to set financial goals and a budget, unfollow or mute triggering accounts, and use Spendee to track luxury spending and identify patterns; stress and boredom were recognized as common contexts for splurging (T400, T402, T404, T406). Further plans included a feelings journal, coping with stress through exercise or meditation, waiting 24 hours before buying, and seeking perspective from friends or family; the user liked celebrating small wins (T408). No implementation or later outcome was reported. The interval from purchase to planning was within about one week.

Considering a Fuerteventura surf trip: On 2023-04-02, the user asked about water sports in the Canary Islands and was told Fuerteventura is a strong surfing destination (T145, T146, T147, T148). The user then said they thought they would plan a trip there (T149), asked about affordable accommodation, and said they would check Surf Riders Fuerteventura because they were interested in lessons (T151, T152, T153). The assistant described board and wetsuit rentals there (T153, T154). No booking or completed trip was reported; the planning steps occurred on the same day.

The user’s family of four aimed to have dinner together at least three times per week, usually Tuesday, Thursday, and Sunday; the user said the routine had been nice and wanted to maintain it (2023-04-02; T458, T460, T466, T468).

The user's 2022 employee-turnover figures were 169 departures, January headcount 741, and December headcount 809; using average headcount (775), the calculated turnover rate was 21.81%, approximately 22% (2022-01-01..2022-12-31; T104, T105). In a separate calculation with an unspecified period, the user supplied 177 departures and average headcount 700, producing approximately 25.29% turnover (2023-04-02; T96, T100, T101). These are two distinct calculations, not a single continuous rate series.

The user reported at least two difficult or uncertain experiences in developing a meditation routine: by 2023-04-02, they were struggling to stay consistent after a 2023-02-27 workshop, and they were also trying to build a daily practice after a five-day March retreat (2023-02-27..2023-04-02; T170, T174, T175; workshop and living-room details lack source IDs). These accounts may overlap and should not be treated as separate failed attempts.
